walls.note: The street-side (east) edge with the cut inscription, the polyhedron and the figure (panoramas 00080/00081 and TMX 002926 46).

items.where: bronze figure at the north end of the slab: long cloak with vertical folds, narrow shoulders, curly shoulder-length hair, calm face turned toward the polyhedron, small bird and leaf shapes raised on the cloak
items.how: builder: elliptic cloak cylinder with a slight hem flare, nine fold ribs, shoulder ellipsoid, ellipsoid skull with brow, nose, mouth and chin, shoulder-length curly hair as one smooth overlapping mass (cap, back fall, a fall over each ear, sideburn curls, nape curls); fourteen raised bird/leaf ellipsoids; no cloak creases below rib scale

items.where: dark stone polyhedron resting on a vertex at the south end of the slab
items.how: builder: stretched, tilted icosahedron (20 faces) seated on the slab; the real faces are irregular

items.where: HET DOEL VAN DE STAAT IS DE VRIJHEID cut along the east edge, SPINOZA on the step at the figure end
items.how: builder: raised stroke-font capitals (letterBoxes) in dark grey; the real letters are incised serif capitals

items.where: oval granite slab 0.5 m high on a slightly proud footing course, a low step block under the figure
items.how: builder: the OSM outline extruded, footing course, step block

walls.note: The canal side: plain granite edge, figure from behind; seen only over the slab in the east views.
